instructions: Review the diff and post inline comments with concrete suggestions. The rules of this repository are in AGENTS.md, kicad/README.md, logo/README.md and, for the social pack under social/, social/AGENTS.md (listed in files.json): cite the rule a finding breaks. Generated files are reviewed through their sources (tools/build.py writes them and CI fails when one is stale), so the ignored paths are not missing from the review. Never comment on the pull request's title or description.

rules.rule: The mark is always whole: the keyhole inside its ring at every size, never ringless, redrawn or recolored; under 24 px only the small mark at a size logo/src/small-mark.json lists.
Every color in a source is a token's value from tokens/tokens.json; no opacity, tint, gradient, shadow or filter. A new color is a new token first.
No live text in anything published: words are outlines made by tools/kleidos_brand/lettering.py from the pinned fonts, and the fonts under fonts/ are never subset, instanced or converted.

Nothing private: no home-directory path, private network or hardware address, serial port, host name, token, key, private setting, or e-mail address other than mail@kleidos.dev and jmrplens@kleidos.dev; metadata records hold no date, tool name, path, host or camera data.

Declared licenses are GPL-3.0-or-later, MIT or OFL-1.1 only, as REUSE.toml draws them; a new kind of file is covered by REUSE.toml in the same change, and a new third-party source gets its notice in NOTICE.md.
Markdown prose is never hard-wrapped: one line per paragraph and per list item. Text between BEGIN GENERATED and END GENERATED markers is never edited by hand.

Write the vendors M5Stack and LILYGO; the glyph is a keyhole (Spanish cerradura), never a key or llave; Spanish never says vault or bóveda (the container is llavero); never the registered-trademark sign beside Kleidos; facts only as about/facts.json states them.

tools/kleidos_brand/ is imported by the social pack (social/tools/): a rename or signature change of a public name breaks the pack unless it changes with it. A new rule of tools/check.py comes with a test in tests/ that plants the defect in the throwaway tree copy.

Workflow actions are pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment, checkout sets persist-credentials: false, every job has an emoji name and timeout-minutes, and slow jobs wait for the cheap gates through needs. The quality kit's workflows are called by its name, @v3, never by a commit; the last job, ✅ Check, follows the kit's model word for word.

The social pack, moved here from the kleidos-dev/social repository (social/MOVED.md): its rules are social/AGENTS.md and its check social/tools/check.py. Everything is drawn from brand (mark always whole with its ring, token colors, Mona Sans, no opacity, tint, gradient, shadow, filter, font file or embedded picture). social/png/, social/svg/readme/, social/previews/, social/exports.json and social/README.md's generated blocks are written by social/tools/export.py only. The banner paths under readme_banners.consumers in social/pack.json are a public contract read by every README: flag a rename, move or removal.
